name: menu
description: Three straight menu bars with rounded ends. Fixed Bold 2.25 filled geometry.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner changed the Filled concept to Bold rather than a boxed cutout. Filled is fixed fill-only geometry matching the exact Outline centerlines rendered at Bold 2.25, with round cap radius 1.125. Outline retains default Regular 1.70 and radius-.85 caps. Both styles share centerlines and placement; weight is deliberately different. Centerlines are sized for exact 2px primary-pair margins at the Filled Bold reference. Regular Outline therefore has 2.275px on that same primary pair. No enclosing box or negative-space symbol is present. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Both revised styles await owner review; earlier boxed approval does not approve this revision. Three straight equal centerlines x=3.125..20.875 at y=6,12,18. Filled visible bounds x=2..22/y=4.875..19.125; horizontal is the primary pair. Vertical margins preserve the natural bar spacing. Each bar is an analytical radius-1.125 capsule.

review.note: Owner requested Filled = Bold for Menu and Search, superseding the previous box treatment. Revised geometry awaits owner review.
